# Vylos Media

> Vylos Media is a video production company based in San Diego, California, founded by Charlie Marinelli, serving businesses across San Diego County, Orange County and Los Angeles (as far north as Malibu). It films, directs, edits and color grades video of any size, from single clips and social content to brand films, promos and ad campaigns.

- Location: San Diego, CA. Films on location across San Diego County (San Diego, Carlsbad, Oceanside, Encinitas, San Marcos, Vista, Escondido, Del Mar, La Jolla and more), Orange County (Irvine, Newport Beach, Huntington Beach, Laguna Beach, San Clemente and more) and Los Angeles up to Malibu (Long Beach, Santa Monica, Malibu). Editing-only projects work from anywhere.
- Services: filming and direction, video editing, color grading, brand films, promo and ad videos, social video. Full production from idea to final cut.
- Pricing: custom quotes based on video length, number of videos and whether filming is on location. The first Reel is free for new clients.
- Contact: charlie@vylosmedia.com · Instagram @vylosmedia · https://vylosmedia.com/#contact
